title: Blade Clash Arena
description: Enter a frantic IO sword-fighting arena—collect spinning blades, slash rivals from the flank, and grow an unstoppable ring of legendary steel.
controls: Drag to glide across the arena, pick up scattered swords to grow your blade ring, and cut down rivals.

zh-CN.title: 刀剑争霸
zh-CN.description: 魔性冷兵器乱斗刀剑争霸：在竞技场收集飞剑壮大刀阵，走位拉扯收割对手，化身满屏剑气的无敌剑圣！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动走位拾取场上散落刀剑扩充剑阵，灵活贴身收割其他对手登顶榜首。
